skill.name: gemini-api-dev
skill.description: Use Python and TypeScript examples to build with the Gemini Interactions API. Consult the migration checklist to update existing Gemini integrations.
skill.summary: Develop and migrate Gemini API integrations with SDK examples and compatibility checklists.
skill.author: google-gemini

security_audit.summary: Of 180 static alerts, 178 are false positives; two examples configure a remote agent to fetch an unverified repository. The skill claims override authority and recommends installing another skill without approval. Its stateful examples rely on default provider retention.

remediation.issue: The model guidance claims override authority.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the override language. Direct readers to verify model IDs in current vendor documentation and keep user permissions in force.

remediation.issue: Both custom-agent examples hardcode an unverified repository source.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicitly approved repository. Use read-only access and verify which data the hosted agent can read before provisioning it.

remediation.issue: Stateful examples use default provider storage without a data-handling checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Use non-sensitive examples and explain how to opt out when state is unnecessary. Require a retention review before processing sensitive inputs.

remediation.issue: The Live API note requests installation of a separate skill without approval.
remediation.suggestion: Make the Live API skill an optional reference. Request approval and verify its source before installing it.

content.user_title: Build and Migrate Gemini API Integrations
content.value_statement: Gemini API versions differ in how they handle requests, responses, and streaming. Use Python and TypeScript examples and a migration checklist to plan and verify changes.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to generate text and read the final response in Python and TypeScript.
Demonstrates multi-turn conversations using a previous interaction ID and explains the storage requirement.
Shows how to read incremental text and final token usage from streaming events.
Provides sample Decisions API requests and links to the schemas for choices and rubric scores.
Maps legacy generateContent requests, responses, and tool calls to the Interactions API.
Shows how to start hosted research and poll for completion in both SDKs.
limitations: Live examples require a configured Gemini account, credentials, and an appropriate SDK version.
Managed agents and the Decisions API examples require beta API access.
Disabling provider storage prevents reuse of previous interaction IDs and background execution.
The guide links to hosted documentation for details. It does not confirm which models or features your account can use.

use_cases.title: Make a First Text Request
use_cases.description: Set up the Python SDK, send a sample prompt, and check that the response includes text.

use_cases.title: Display a Streaming Reply
use_cases.description: Separate incremental text from completion events in a TypeScript application.

use_cases.title: Review a Legacy API Upgrade
use_cases.description: Identify request, response, and tool-call changes before approving a scoped migration.

prompt_templates.title: Start with Text Generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a minimal Python Interactions API example with a sample prompt. Show how to read the final text without embedding a key or making a live call.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Two-Turn Conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Show a two-turn TypeScript conversation using fictional data. Explain how previous interaction IDs depend on provider storage and describe a stateless alternative.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Streaming Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a TypeScript example that separates incremental text from final usage. Include a test plan for interrupted streams using mock events.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Scoped API Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review only the files I list for migration to the Interactions API. Map request options, response handling, and tool calls. Propose regression tests before editing.

output_examples.input: How should I display a streamed TypeScript reply?
output: Append text as text delta events arrive.
Read token usage from the completion event and keep it separate from the visible reply.
Test the handler with simulated events before using a live request.

output_examples.input: What should I verify when updating a two-turn Python conversation?
output: Confirm the new request returns a model output step with text.
Send the first interaction ID with the second request and check that context is preserved.
Confirm that provider storage is appropriate for the data before enabling server-side state.

best_practices: Check the current vendor documentation for the selected model, API version, and SDK.
Keep credentials outside source code and use sample data until retention and remote access policies are approved.
Confirm migration scope and test the response behavior before changing additional files.
anti_patterns: Assuming a model change alone migrates a generateContent integration.
Expecting a previous interaction ID to work after disabling storage.
Copying a remote agent example with a repository that has not been approved.

faq.question: Which languages have examples?
faq.answer: The skill includes Python and JavaScript or TypeScript SDK examples.

faq.question: Can it guide a generateContent migration?
faq.answer: Yes. The checklist covers SDK calls, response steps, streaming events, conversation state, and tool calls.

faq.question: Can I use server-side conversation state without storage?
faq.answer: No. The guide says that disabling storage prevents reuse of a previous interaction ID and disables background execution.

faq.question: Which examples require the beta API?
faq.answer: The managed-agent and Decisions API examples use the beta API.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee a model is available to my account?
faq.answer: No. Check current model availability, pricing, and access requirements before deploying.

faq.question: Does the skill include the Gemini Live API workflow?
faq.answer: No. It points to a separate Live API skill, which is not bundled with this one.
